symbols.zh: ω 角频率；k,l 水平波数；K 水平总波数；m 垂向波数；H 水深；f 科氏参数；β=df/dy；N 浮力频率；Rd 变形半径；c 相速或模态长波速度。
symbols.en: ω angular frequency; k,l horizontal wavenumbers; K total horizontal wavenumber; m vertical wavenumber; H depth; f Coriolis parameter; β=df/dy; N buoyancy frequency; Rd deformation radius; c phase or modal long-wave speed.

name.zh:
毛细波
Capillary wave

medium.zh: 空气—海水界面

restoring.zh: 表面张力 σ

assumptions.zh: 短波；深水极限常用

dispersive.zh: 强色散；深水 cᵍ=3cₚ/2
dispersive.en: Strong; deep water cᵍ=3cₚ/2

propagation.zh: 短波传播更快；能量随群速
propagation.en: Shorter waves faster; energy at group speed

source.zh: 微风、雨滴、界面扰动
source.en: Light wind, raindrops, interface disturbance

observation.zh: 高频海面纹理、实验波槽
observation.en: High-frequency ripples, wave tanks

name.zh:
表面重力波
Surface gravity wave

medium.zh: 自由海面；运动随深度衰减
medium.en: Free surface; motion decays with depth

restoring.zh: 重力 g

assumptions.zh: 线性、小振幅；任意水深

dispersive.zh: 深水色散；深水 cᵍ=cₚ/2
dispersive.en: Deep water dispersive; cᵍ=cₚ/2

propagation.zh: 深水长波更快；近岸折射、浅化、破碎
propagation.en: Longer deep-water waves faster; refract, shoal and break near shore

source.zh: 局地风、远处风暴、船舶
source.en: Local wind, distant storms, vessels

observation.zh: 浮标波高/周期、雷达、卫星高度计
observation.en: Buoy height/period, radar, altimetry

name.zh:
浅水长波／海啸
Shallow-water wave / tsunami

medium.zh: 全水深近同相运动

restoring.zh: 重力；海面坡度

assumptions.zh: kH≪1；静水压力

dispersion.zh: 无旋转 ω²=gHK²；含旋转 ω²=f²+gHK²

dispersive.zh: 均匀水深近无色散；c=√(gH)
dispersive.en: Nearly non-dispersive at uniform depth; c=√(gH)

propagation.zh: 深海快、近岸减速增高；可跨洋
propagation.en: Fast in deep water, slows and grows near shore; basin crossing

source.zh: 海底地震、滑坡、火山、撞击
source.en: Seafloor earthquake, landslide, volcano, impact

observation.zh: DART 底压、验潮站、GNSS 浮标
observation.en: DART bottom pressure, tide gauges, GNSS buoys

name.zh:
潮汐长波
Tidal wave

medium.zh: 全球海洋与陆架

restoring.zh: 重力；天体潮汐势周期强迫

assumptions.zh: 旋转浅水方程；盆地几何

dispersion.zh: 受迫频率固定；自由模局地近似 ω²=f²+gHK²
dispersion.en: Forced frequency fixed; free modes locally ω²=f²+gHK²

dispersive.zh: 传播近无色散；共振与摩擦改变响应
dispersive.en: Nearly non-dispersive; resonance and friction shape response

propagation.zh: 旋转盆地中的 Kelvin/Poincaré 型响应
propagation.en: Kelvin/Poincaré-like response in rotating basins

source.zh: 月、日引潮力
source.en: Lunar and solar tidal potential

observation.zh: 验潮站、卫星高度计、潮流仪
observation.en: Tide gauges, altimetry, current meters

name.zh:
海湾静振
Seiche

medium.zh: 封闭或半封闭湖湾、港池
medium.en: Enclosed or semi-enclosed basins and harbours

restoring.zh: 重力；边界反射形成驻波

assumptions.zh: 一维均匀浅水盆地近似

dispersive.zh: 离散本征模；频率由几何决定
dispersive.en: Discrete eigenmodes set by geometry

propagation.zh: 节点与腹点固定；弱阻尼时持续
propagation.en: Fixed nodes/antinodes; persists under weak damping

source.zh: 风压突变、气压、海啸、船波
source.en: Wind setup, pressure jumps, tsunamis, ship waves

observation.zh: 验潮站、压力计；港湾共振风险
observation.en: Tide gauges, pressure sensors; harbour resonance risk

name.zh:
风暴潮
Storm surge

medium.zh: 陆架、近岸与河口

restoring.zh: 风应力与低气压强迫；重力调整
restoring.en: Wind stress and low pressure forcing; gravity adjustment

assumptions.zh: 受迫、耗散的旋转浅水响应

dispersion.zh: 无唯一自由频散式；自由部分近似 ω²=f²+gHK²
dispersion.en: No unique free dispersion; free part ≈f²+gHK²

dispersive.zh: 受地形、摩擦、共振和移动风暴控制
dispersive.en: Controlled by topography, friction, resonance and storm motion

propagation.zh: 常与潮汐叠加；浅海和漏斗形海湾放大
propagation.en: Adds to tides; amplified on shallow shelves and funnel bays

source.zh: 热带/温带气旋、强持续风
source.en: Tropical/extratropical cyclones, persistent wind

observation.zh: 验潮站、浮标、气压、风场与数值预报
observation.en: Gauges, buoys, pressure/wind fields and forecasts

name.zh:
内重力波
Internal gravity wave

medium.zh: 稳定层结海洋内部

restoring.zh: 浮力；旋转提供低频界限

assumptions.zh: Boussinesq、线性、均匀 N 与 f
assumptions.en: Boussinesq, linear, uniform N and f

dispersive.zh: 强色散；自由传播通常 |f|<|ω|<N
dispersive.en: Strongly dispersive; usually |f|<|ω|<N

scale.zh: 水平 0.1–100 km；垂向模态/波束

propagation.zh: 相位与能量方向可不同；能量沿波束
propagation.en: Phase and energy directions differ; energy follows beams

source.zh: 潮流越过地形、风、对流、流剪切
source.en: Tides over topography, wind, convection, shear

observation.zh: 温盐链、ADCP、Argo/滑翔机、SAR
observation.en: T/S chains, ADCP, Argo/gliders, SAR

name.zh:
内潮
Internal tide

medium.zh: 层结内部；海岭与陆坡附近生成

restoring.zh: 浮力；潮汐周期强迫

assumptions.zh: 内波垂向模态；ω 固定为潮频
assumptions.en: Internal-wave modes; ω fixed at tidal frequency

dispersion.zh: ω=ω潮；水平波数由内波频散式与模态决定
dispersion.en: ω=ωtide; horizontal wavenumber set by internal-wave dispersion and mode

dispersive.zh: 多模态、可相干跨盆地；非线性时转为孤立波
dispersive.en: Multimodal, coherently basin-spanning; may steepen into solitary waves

period.zh: 主要 12.42 h 或 24 h 附近

propagation.zh: 从生成地辐射；模态群速不同
propagation.en: Radiates from generation sites; modal group speeds differ

source.zh: 正压潮流跨越海脊、海峡、陆坡
source.en: Barotropic tide over ridges, straits and slopes

observation.zh: 卫星高度计/SAR、潜标、剖面与微结构
observation.en: Altimetry/SAR, moorings, profiles and microstructure

name.zh:
惯性振荡／惯性波
Inertial oscillation

medium.zh: 海洋混合层与旋转流体内部
medium.en: Ocean mixed layer and rotating-fluid interior

restoring.zh: 科氏力

assumptions.zh: 水平无压强梯度的自由惯性运动
assumptions.en: Free horizontal motion without pressure gradient

dispersion.zh: 局地惯性振荡 ω=±f；三维惯性波 |ω|≤2Ω

dispersive.zh: 局地频率由纬度决定；赤道 f→0
dispersive.en: Local frequency set by latitude; f→0 at equator

propagation.zh: 北半球水平速度顺时针旋转
propagation.en: Horizontal velocity rotates clockwise in NH

source.zh: 风暴突然停止/改变、混合层调整
source.en: Abrupt wind change, mixed-layer adjustment

observation.zh: 漂流浮标、ADCP、流速时间序列
observation.en: Drifters, ADCP and current time series

name.zh:
Poincaré／惯性—重力波
Poincaré / inertia–gravity

medium.zh: 旋转浅水层；海洋或大气等效层
medium.en: Rotating shallow-water layer in ocean or atmosphere

restoring.zh: 重力/浮力 + 科氏力

assumptions.zh: f 平面、线性浅水、波速 c
assumptions.en: f-plane, linear shallow water, speed c

dispersive.zh: 有截止频率 |f|；高波数趋近重力波
dispersive.en: Cutoff at |f|; approaches gravity wave at high wavenumber

propagation.zh: 可向各方向传播；相速与群速不同
propagation.en: Propagates in any direction; phase and group speeds differ

source.zh: 快速质量/动量扰动、地转调整
source.en: Rapid mass/momentum disturbance, geostrophic adjustment

observation.zh: 海平面/位势高度、风流场频谱
observation.en: Sea level/geopotential and velocity spectra

name.zh:
沿岸 Kelvin 波
Coastal Kelvin wave

medium.zh: 海岸、陆坡或垂直边界附近
medium.en: Near a coast, slope or vertical boundary

restoring.zh: 沿岸重力传播 + 横岸地转平衡

assumptions.zh: 线性浅水；边界法向流为零
assumptions.en: Linear shallow water; zero normal flow at boundary

dispersive.zh: 理想情况下无色散；边界选择单向支
dispersive.en: Ideally non-dispersive; boundary selects one branch

propagation.zh: 北半球传播时海岸在右侧
propagation.en: In NH the coast lies to the right of propagation

source.zh: 风、潮汐、海啸、边界调整
source.en: Wind, tides, tsunamis, boundary adjustment

observation.zh: 沿岸验潮站相位、卫星高度计
observation.en: Coastal gauge phase and satellite altimetry

name.zh:
Rossby／行星波
Rossby / planetary wave

medium.zh: 海洋与大气大尺度内部

restoring.zh: 背景位涡梯度 β 与位涡守恒
restoring.en: Background PV gradient β and PV conservation

assumptions.zh: β 平面、准地转、线性

dispersive.zh: 强色散；静止背景中波相通常向西
dispersive.en: Strongly dispersive; phase usually westward in resting medium

propagation.zh: 相速向西；群速可与相速不同甚至向东
propagation.en: Westward phase; group velocity can differ or be eastward

source.zh: 风应力、加热、地形、流不稳定
source.en: Wind stress, heating, topography, flow instability

observation.zh: SSH/位势高度、OLR、再分析与 Hovmöller 图
observation.en: SSH/geopotential, OLR, reanalysis and Hovmöller diagrams

name.zh:
地形 Rossby／陆架波
Topographic Rossby / shelf wave

medium.zh: 陆架坡折、海山和等深线附近

restoring.zh: 水深变化产生的地形位涡梯度
restoring.en: Topographic PV gradient from depth changes

assumptions.zh: 准地转、弱坡度；沿等深线传播

dispersive.zh: 低频色散；公式符号依坐标/坡向
dispersive.en: Low-frequency dispersive; sign depends on coordinates/slope

propagation.zh: 沿等深线；北半球常使浅水位于右侧
propagation.en: Along isobaths; often shallow water on right in NH

source.zh: 沿坡流扰动、风、涡旋和潮汐
source.en: Slope-current disturbances, wind, eddies and tides

observation.zh: 陆架流速阵列、底压、海平面
observation.en: Shelf current arrays, bottom pressure and sea level

name.zh:
赤道 Kelvin 波
Equatorial Kelvin wave

medium.zh: 赤道海洋/大气，赤道附近俘获

restoring.zh: 重力 + β 效应；经向风/流 v=0
restoring.en: Gravity plus β effect; meridional velocity v=0

assumptions.zh: 赤道 β 平面、浅水等效深度 hₑ

dispersive.zh: 理想情况下无色散；高斯型经向俘获
dispersive.en: Ideally non-dispersive; Gaussian meridional trapping

propagation.zh: 东传；海洋第一斜压模常约 2–3 m s⁻¹
propagation.en: Eastward; first oceanic baroclinic mode often 2–3 m s⁻¹

source.zh: 风异常、MJO/对流、ENSO 调整
source.en: Wind anomalies, MJO/convection, ENSO adjustment

observation.zh: 赤道海平面、跃层深度、OLR 与风
observation.en: Equatorial SSH, thermocline depth, OLR and wind

name.zh:
赤道 Rossby 波
Equatorial Rossby wave

medium.zh: 赤道两侧对称/反对称模态

restoring.zh: 赤道 β 与位涡守恒

assumptions.zh: 长波低频近似；模态序号 n≥1

dispersive.zh: 色散；静止背景中西传
dispersive.en: Dispersive; westward in resting medium

propagation.zh: 西传；在赤道两侧出现涡旋对
propagation.en: Westward; gyre pairs straddle equator

source.zh: 热带加热、风应力和 Kelvin 波反射
source.en: Tropical heating, wind stress and reflected Kelvin waves

observation.zh: OLR、风、SSH 与跃层异常
observation.en: OLR, winds, SSH and thermocline anomalies

name.zh:
混合 Rossby—重力波／Yanai 波
Mixed Rossby–gravity wave

medium.zh: 赤道海洋与大气；n=0 模态

restoring.zh: 重力与位涡梯度共同作用

assumptions.zh: 赤道 β 平面浅水方程

dispersive.zh: 西传长波似 Rossby；东传短波似重力波
dispersive.en: Westward long waves are Rossby-like; eastward short waves gravity-like

propagation.zh: 可东/西传；经向风跨赤道为反对称
propagation.en: Eastward or westward; meridional wind antisymmetric

source.zh: 热带对流、风和初始扰动
source.en: Tropical convection, wind and initial disturbances

observation.zh: OLR—风谱、赤道流速/海平面
observation.en: OLR–wind spectra, equatorial currents/SSH

name.zh:
赤道惯性—重力波
Equatorial inertia–gravity wave

medium.zh: 赤道波导；高频分支

restoring.zh: 重力/浮力 + β 效应

assumptions.zh: 赤道浅水方程；n≥0

dispersive.zh: 东传和西传高频支；有赤道俘获
dispersive.en: Eastward and westward high-frequency branches; trapped

propagation.zh: 相速快于赤道 Rossby；能量可上下传播
propagation.en: Faster phase than equatorial Rossby; energy may propagate vertically

source.zh: 深对流、加热脉冲、地转调整
source.en: Deep convection, heating pulses, geostrophic adjustment

observation.zh: OLR、风场、温度和位势高度谱
observation.en: OLR, winds, temperature and geopotential spectra

name.zh:
大气重力波／山岳波
Atmospheric gravity / mountain wave

medium.zh: 稳定层结对流层至中高层大气
medium.en: Stably stratified troposphere to upper atmosphere

restoring.zh: 浮力；旋转修正低频

assumptions.zh: 线性、Boussinesq/非弹性；本征频率 ω̂=ω−U·k

dispersive.zh: 强色散；山岳波在地面系常 ω≈0
dispersive.en: Strongly dispersive; mountain waves often ω≈0 in ground frame

propagation.zh: 能量常向上传播；破碎后产生重力波拖曳
propagation.en: Energy often upward; breaking produces gravity-wave drag

source.zh: 地形、对流、急流/锋面、风切变
source.en: Topography, convection, jets/fronts and shear

observation.zh: 卫星亮温/气辉、雷达、探空、激光雷达
observation.en: Satellite brightness/airglow, radar, soundings, lidar

name.zh:
声波
Acoustic wave

medium.zh: 可压缩海水或大气；大气中最典型
medium.en: Compressible ocean or atmosphere; most familiar in air

restoring.zh: 可压缩性产生的压力梯度

assumptions.zh: 均匀无耗散介质；忽略重力/旋转

dispersive.zh: 理想均匀介质无色散；cₛ 为空气/海水声速
dispersive.en: Non-dispersive in ideal uniform medium; speed cₛ

propagation.zh: 纵向压缩波；空气约 340 m s⁻¹，海水约 1500 m s⁻¹
propagation.en: Longitudinal compression wave; ~340 m s⁻¹ in air, ~1500 m s⁻¹ in seawater

source.zh: 爆炸、雷暴、火山、机械振动
source.en: Explosions, thunderstorms, volcanoes, mechanical vibration

observation.zh: 微气压计、水听器、声学遥感
observation.en: Microbarometers, hydrophones, acoustic remote sensing

name.zh:
Lamb 波
Lamb wave

medium.zh: 大气边界附近的水平压缩模态

restoring.zh: 可压缩性 + 重力维持的垂向结构

assumptions.zh: 等温/静力大气；垂直速度近零、垂向衰减
assumptions.en: Isothermal/hydrostatic atmosphere; near-zero vertical velocity, evanescent

dispersive.zh: 理想情况下近无色散；可绕地球传播多圈
dispersive.en: Nearly non-dispersive ideally; can circle the globe repeatedly

propagation.zh: 接近声速水平传播；地面气压信号突出
propagation.en: Near-acoustic horizontal speed; strong surface-pressure signal

source.zh: 大型火山喷发、爆炸、强对流
source.en: Major eruptions, explosions and intense convection

observation.zh: 全球微气压计与地面气压网
observation.en: Global infrasound and surface-pressure networks

name.zh:
大气潮汐
Atmospheric tide

medium.zh: 全球大气；随高度振幅常增大
medium.en: Global atmosphere; amplitude often increases with height

restoring.zh: 太阳加热/引潮势周期强迫；重力与旋转
restoring.en: Periodic solar heating/tidal potential; gravity and rotation

assumptions.zh: Laplace 潮汐方程；Hough 水平模态
assumptions.en: Laplace tidal equations; Hough horizontal modes

dispersion.zh: 受迫于 24 h、12 h 等频率；垂向波数由等效深度决定
dispersion.en: Forced at 24 h, 12 h, etc.; vertical wavenumber set by equivalent depth

dispersive.zh: 多 Hough 模态；辐射、摩擦与背景风影响
dispersive.en: Multiple Hough modes; affected by radiation, friction and mean wind

propagation.zh: 迁移潮随太阳向西；非迁移潮可东西传播
propagation.en: Migrating tide follows the Sun westward; nonmigrating tides vary

source.zh: 臭氧/水汽吸收太阳辐射、潜热与地形
source.en: Solar absorption by ozone/water vapour, latent heating and topography

observation.zh: 雷达、卫星温度/风、气压
observation.en: Radar, satellite temperature/winds and pressure

name.zh:
天气尺度斜压 Rossby 波
Synoptic baroclinic Rossby wave

medium.zh: 中纬度对流层急流与锋区
medium.en: Midlatitude tropospheric jets and frontal zones

restoring.zh: 位涡梯度；斜压不稳定可放大扰动
restoring.en: PV gradients; baroclinic instability can amplify disturbances

assumptions.zh: 准地转、分层、垂向风切变

dispersion.zh: 实部近 Rossby：ω≈Uk−βk/(K²+Rd⁻²)；不稳定时 Im(ω)>0
dispersion.en: Real part Rossby-like: ω≈Uk−βk/(K²+Rd⁻²); Im(ω)>0 when unstable

dispersive.zh: 传播且可增长；不是单纯中性自由波
dispersive.en: Propagating and growing; not a purely neutral free wave

propagation.zh: 通常随西风向东；群速造成下游发展
propagation.en: Usually eastward with westerlies; group velocity drives downstream development

source.zh: 南北温度梯度和垂直风切变的可用位能
source.en: Available potential energy from meridional temperature gradient and vertical shear

observation.zh: 500 hPa 高度、卫星云图、再分析涡度/位涡
observation.en: 500-hPa height, satellite clouds and reanalysis vorticity/PV
